For the Receptor client (U1), adapt the referenced receptor-client repository and use Spring WebClient with Jackson JSON for reactive HTTP API calls to Diego runtime.
For stream/job repository refactoring (U2) and persistent stream repository (U4), use Spring Data JPA with a relational database (H2 for tests, PostgreSQL for production) to persist metadata.
For the pluggable runtime SPI (U3), define a RuntimeProvider interface and use Spring's dependency injection with profile/condition-based selection for CF, on-prem, and Mesos implementations.
For Spark/Spark Streaming support (U6), integrate the latest Spark Structured Streaming version compatible with XD and provide sample pipeline DSL definitions.
For Import Options (U8), replace the generic --args passthrough with strongly-typed @ConfigurationProperties bound parameters.
Documentation will be authored in AsciiDoc within the existing project docs module.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD codebase is available, compiles, and has working test infrastructure; this increment extends it.
The referenced receptor-client GitHub repository provides a sufficient base; we adapt rather than build a client from scratch.
Only three runtime targets (Cloud Foundry, on-prem, Mesos) are required for the SPI; other targets can be added later.
Effort estimates include writing unit and integration tests by the same developer, but exclude separate QA, UAT, deployment, and production support.
The developer is a senior Java/Spring engineer familiar with XD, so no significant training or learning curve is included.
U6 is interpreted as providing XD integration modules and example streaming pipelines for the latest Spark/Spark Streaming specs, not modifying Spark itself.
Documentation tasks (U5, U7) only require writing content in-repo; no separate documentation publishing pipeline work is needed.
